preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.
K is an integer between 2 and 9 inclusive.
K raised to the power of N is between 2 and 4095 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(substring in return_value for substring in set(''.join(p) for p in itertools.product(str(i) for i in range(K), repeat=N)))
postconditions.description: The return value contains all possible strings of size N using characters from 0 to K-1 as substrings.
The length of the return value is K^N + N - 1, which is the minimum length required to contain all possible substrings of size N.
